artboards.title: Kit page · desktop 1440 · the drawing office

annotations.text:
Kit product page — road kit as the worked example.
LEADING DIRECTION (Main + Phone): 'the drawing office' — the live site's drawing-sheet grid, titleblock, node divider and lime culm, turned into the kit's own device: an exploded parts drawing with numbered callouts that draw in, a culm that grows as the build timeline, and a hand-drawn pictogram per spec cell.
All values are the live theme's: forest #003C32 · lime #D4FD62 · bone #E6DCC8 · paper #F1E9D8 · steel #DEE6F0 · Atkinson Hyperlegible · 2.5px ink stamps with 5px offset shadow · eyebrow 14px lowercase with lime dash.
Copy is Claims Register safe; one bracketed [to verify] stat. Motion is CSS on divs only (no SVG animation), inert under reduced-motion.
B and C below are alternates to react to, not finished.

If Main is the direction: it implements as sections on bbc-product-2026 + bbc-kit-spec (pictogram block setting) + a new bbc-kit-drawing hero section. Shipping rates and the 95% stat need James before they ship.
